outgoing.name: Chicago
outgoing.excerpt: Griffith ( July 4, 1907, Chicago – October 12, 1958) was an American assistant director, film producer, and one of the first child actors.

outgoing.name: Chimpanzee
outgoing.excerpt: He was required to do his own stunts, such as climbing trees, swinging from vines, and interacting closely with a chimpanzee.

outgoing.name: Silent film
outgoing.excerpt: Griffith worked in the film industry for five decades, acting in over sixty films, and surviving the transition from silent films to talkies—films with sound.
